title: NormalizedTranscript
description: Vendor-neutral transcript format. Every adapter (Gong, Fireflies, Otter, Zoom, VTT, SRT, plain text, or any other recorder) — plus the native Attention source — normalizes into this shape. The coaching pipeline only ever reads this format, never a vendor's raw payload.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this transcript document.

call_id.description: Stable identifier for the call, if known. Falls back to a content hash.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 start time of the call, if known.

source.description: Provenance of the transcript so reports are auditable.

adapter.description: Which GTM Superintelligence adapter produced this document.

participants.description: Everyone on the call. Roles drive coaching (we only coach the 'rep' side).

side.description: 'rep' = the seller/CSM being coached. 'prospect'/'customer' = the buyer side. 'partner'/'internal' for partner & internal calls.

title.description: Job title if known, e.g. 'VP Sales'.

turns.description: Ordered speaker turns. This is the only required content field.

speaker.description: Participant id or display name. Should resolve to a participant when possible.

side.description: Denormalized side for convenience; resolved from participants when absent.

metadata.description: Free-form context that improves coaching: CRM stage, deal amount, prior call summaries, etc. Never required.
